## How it works

- [statement] CoinGecko assigns the Aero Slipstream (Base) exchange API ID `aero-slipstream-base`. Use this venue identifier when selecting Base Slipstream markets in CoinGecko data. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-05) — https://www.coingecko.com/en/exchanges/aero-slipstream-base · keywords: Aero markets and coins data

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Aero describes Markets figures as comparison estimates rather than onchain values. Stake APR estimates what Allocation Power directed to a pool earns; it should not be substituted for the return of a concentrated LP position. (low confidence) — https://app.aero.xyz/docs/llms-full.txt · keywords: Aero markets and coins data
- [statement] CoinGecko identifies the migrated Aero coin with API ID `aero` and states that it migrated from an old contract to a new contract. Resolve the migrated asset explicitly rather than selecting it by the shared AERO symbol. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-05) — https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/aero · keywords: Aero markets and coins data
- [statement] CoinGecko reports that circulating supply for the migrated Aero token is not reported. Treat this as missing provider data rather than evidence that the token has no circulating supply. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-05) — https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/aero · keywords: Aero markets and coins data
- [statement] CoinGecko documents the coins/markets endpoint for coin-level market data. Its response includes nullable current price and total volume and a last-update timestamp; these fields describe a coin rather than a particular Aero pool. (low confidence) — https://docs.coingecko.com/reference/coins-markets · keywords: Aero markets and coins data
- [statement] CoinGecko warns that an unverified token market cap returns null and that pool addresses absent from GeckoTerminal are ignored. A missing result therefore requires a coverage check rather than treating it as a zero-valued market. (low confidence) — https://docs.coingecko.com/reference/pool-address · keywords: Aero markets and coins data

## Facts and statements

- [statement] CoinGecko documents `/onchain/networks/{network}/pools/{address}` for an individual network and pool address, with pool-level volume and reserve value. This is the pool-specific data interface to evaluate separately from coin-level market data. (low confidence) — https://docs.coingecko.com/reference/pool-address · keywords: Aero markets and coins data
